video_metadata.author: Staff Sgt. Joseph Tolliver
video_metadata.description: U.S. Army and Indian Army soldiers are training to become a cohesive team, on Joint Base Lewis–McChord, during exercise Yudh Abhyas 2019. The joint training is designed to build the two armies joint capacity, and share culture and knowledge to support the Pacific region.
